Introduction

JUNNY is a Korean-Canadian singer-songwriter and producer based in South Korea, currently signed to MAUVE Company. He officially debuted on April 6, 2017, with the extended play “Monochrome,” and has since gained recognition for his smooth R&B sound, introspective lyrics, and active involvement in composing and producing both his own music and songs for other artists.

Fun facts

1
Junny was discovered by a freelance producer in Canada, to whom he sent some demo tracks. One of the demos caught the attention of Luhan (formerly of EXO), who expressed interest in purchasing it — leading to Junny's first song sale.
…
2
Junny fulfilled a long-held personal goal by appearing as a guest on the Daebak Show, a popular podcast hosted by Eric Nam.
…
3
From creating music in his parents' basement, Junny rose to co-producing tracks for major artists like EXO's Kai, NCT Dream, and IU.
…
4
Junny was one of the hosts for the first 12 episodes of Season 2 of Dive Studios' podcast “Get Real,” teaming up with Ashley Choi (formerly of LADIES' CODE) and Peniel from BTOB.
…
5
As of July 22, 2025, JUNNY has 135 songwriting credits registered under his name (No. 10024387) on KOMCA.
